title: LA Colossal – Vermilion Najeon 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her early 50s, black hair in a tall eonjeun-meori updo with mother-of-pearl tteoljam, natural face with a confident smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the throne seat, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer clearly different from skin, inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl phoenixes and peonies. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Joseon style.

Pose: Seated on a carved wooden throne, torso facing the camera, both forearms resting on the armrests, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch vermilion lacquer platform Mary Jane stilettos with pearl buckles.
Nails: Extra long stiletto nails, vermilion with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: Joseon throne hall with dancheong beams and an Irworobongdo screen, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm golden key with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
